ReportCaption: SCD Complications during ED Visits Among Californians with SCD, 2021 - 2023
KeyVariables: ed_flag_<condition> for visit counts; ed_flag_any_comp; ed_any_<condition> for percent of people
StratificationsAvailable: sex; age (continuous and all three age categories); race; ethnicity; genotype; county; SVI
RecutNotes: Per-year breakdown NOT available - the underlying flag is built once across 2021-2023. A per-year cut requires re-running the pipeline. VISIT-LEVEL: both published columns are denominated in ED visits (37,917 visits, 17,212 complications), so the ed_flag_* counts are what is tabulated. Use ed_any_* instead if you want a percentage OF PEOPLE - a different quantity. A visit can carry more than one complication, so the rows do not sum to the total. Priapism is shown against male visits only and is excluded from the complication-share column. Individual complications are thin; splenic sequestration in particular. Venous thromboembolism is known to be under-captured - see code-lists.md.

ReportCaption: Individual-Level ED Reliance Ratio and Inpatient Reliance Ratio Among Californians Living with SCD Who Had Medi-Cal Enrollment, 2021 - 2023
Population: Medi-Cal enrolled - required, because the outpatient component is only observable for them
KeyVariables: ind_EDR, ind_IRR, high_EDR, encounters; built from ed_visit_count_total, hosp_visit_count_total, total_amb_count
StratificationsAvailable: sex; age; race; ethnicity; genotype; county; SVI
RecutNotes: Per-year breakdown NOT available - the underlying flag is built once across 2021-2023. A per-year cut requires re-running the pipeline. High reliance is EDR >= 0.33 at the INDIVIDUAL level; that threshold must not be applied to a county aggregate, which is visit-volume weighted and a different quantity. Reliance is undefined for people with no encounters at all and they are excluded from the denominator. Adult-only and other subgroup cuts are available - age_cat_a is present in the merged data.
